How to Use the App

Keeping score, fixing mistakes and finding things. Tap a topic.

📲 Get the app

  1. iPhone: tap the App Store link Dan sends you for B&B Golf, then tap Get. It's free.
  2. Android: open app.bourbonbogeys.com/app in Chrome, tap ⋮, then Add to Home screen. No install needed.
  3. The first time you open your scorecard, a short tour shows you around. The full guide is in the app under More → How to Use the App.

👋 Getting in (just once)

  1. Open the app, type the trip code Dan sent you, and tap Join Tournament.
  2. Tap your name. The app remembers you after that.
  3. Tap Continue to Rounds →, then tap today's round. Your scorecard opens.
  4. Android phones: there's nothing to install. Open app.bourbonbogeys.com/app in Chrome, tap ⋮ then Add to Home screen. It works just like the iPhone app.

✏️ Entering scores

  1. Your group is listed on the scorecard. The highlighted card is the player you're entering a score for.
  2. Tap the score on the number pad. Par is the outlined number. It saves straight away and moves on to the next player.
  3. To score for someone else, tap their card first. One person can keep score for the whole group.
  4. Bigger number than the pad shows? Tap the highest one, then +1 until it's right.
  5. Hole done? Tap › at the top for the next hole. ‹ goes back one.

🩹 Fixing a mistake

  1. This hole: tap the player's card and tap the right number. Clear takes a score off.
  2. An earlier hole: tap ‹ to go back to it, or tap Full Card and tap the box for that hole.
  3. Wrong player? Put the score on the right card, then tap the wrong card and Clear.
  4. Everyone in your group sees the change right away.

🐦 Birdies, eagles and shanks

  1. Enter a birdie or an eagle (gross, not net) and your phone plays a sound. On silent, it stays quiet.
  2. Somebody shank it? Tap their card, then 🫣 Shank. Two shanks, tap it twice. Yourself counts too.
  3. Tapped it by mistake? Tap Undo in the black bar straight away.
  4. Shanks show up on the scorecard, in the Day Recap, and on the trip shank leaderboard.

⚪ Day 2: picking balls (30/40)

  1. Once everyone on your team has a score for the hole, the 30/40 Selection screen pops up.
  2. Tick the scores to keep, then tap Confirm Selection. Do it before you tee off on the next hole.
  3. It shows how many balls your team has left for the nine. On holes 9 and 18 you must use exactly what's left.

🔎 Looking things up

  1. The bar at the bottom: Scorecard, Games (how every game stands), Board (the leaderboard) and More.
  2. More → Full Scorecard: every hole for your group.
  3. More → Payouts: what everyone has won, for the trip or day by day.
  4. More → Day Recap: how your day went against the field, the day's awards and shanks. Tap any day or any player.
  5. More → Team Draft: the live draft board on the Naples website.
  6. Share to WhatsApp: the green button on Day Recap or Payouts writes out the results. Pick the trip group in WhatsApp, then tap Send.

🔠 Easier to read

  1. Bigger text: the app follows your phone's text size. On iPhone: Settings → Display & Brightness → Text Size.
  2. Different colors: More → Text & Colors. It only changes your phone.

❓ Common mix-ups

  1. "You are not assigned to this round": you're not in a group for that day yet. Tell Dan.
  2. "Failed to save score": no signal. Wait until you have signal and tap the score again.
  3. Wrong name on your scorecard: on the Rounds screen tap Sign Out, enter the trip code again and tap your own name.
  4. A screen popped up after a hole on Day 2: that's the 30/40 ball pick (see above).

Questions on the course? Ask Dan.
